name: JMDC Inc.
summary: JMDC Inc. provides medical statistics data services in Japan. It operates through two segments: Health Big Data and Telemedicine. The company offers big data services for medical field, including WEB tool, analytic, raw data provision, and publication support services; data provision and aggregation, consulting, and solution development services; supporting health business for health insurance unions and local government health services; health data platform; and medical institution support services.
